title: Podcasts feature tests
description: Verify the complete Podcasts feature by running xcodegen generate then xcodebuild test -project AggregatorApp.xcodeproj -scheme AggregatorApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17,OS=latest' -quiet. Confirm all spec acceptance criteria are met via build success and static analysis: tab visibility, all list states (empty/loading/error/not-configured), conditional episodeTheme rendering, scrubber isSeeking coordination, speed picker, end-of-episode reset, pagination guard, pull-to-refresh, CF-Access header presence on both API and audio requests, semantic colors, and system fonts.
acceptance_criteria: xcodebuild test exits 0 with no new test failures
All spec acceptance criteria are verifiable from build output and static inspection
